description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers released OG Saahdiq Charles with an injury settlement.
items.impact: Charles had originally been placed on injured reserve.
items.title: Saahdiq Charles released by Panthers with injury settlement

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers waived WR Ainias Smith with an injury settlement.
items.impact: Smith spent all of last season on the Panthers practice squad. He will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.
items.title: Ainias Smith waived by Panthers with injury settlement

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyler Guyton practiced on Thursday.
items.impact: Guyton was limited in practice earlier this week due to an elbow injury. It doesn't appear to be a serious concern.
items.title: Tyler Guyton (elbow) practices Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Overshown was sidelined from practice on Wednesday due to a leg injury. It didn't appear to be a serious concern.
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (leg) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts placed TE Sean McKeon on injured reserve.
items.impact: McKeon will likely miss the upcoming season on injured reserve. The Colts signed Pharaoh Brown as the corresponding move.
items.title: Sean McKeon (shoulder) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts signed TE Pharaoh Brown.
items.impact: Brown appeared in seven games with the Cardinals last season. He'll complete for a depth role in the Colts tight end room.
items.title: Pharaoh Brown signs with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons claimed S Keidron Smith off waivers.
items.impact: Smith was waived by the Jets. Atlanta placed LB Jalon Walker on IR as the corresponding move.
items.title: Keidron Smith claimed off waivers by Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons placed LB Jalon Walker on injured reserve.
items.impact: Walker was diagnosed with a torn ACL earlier this week. He will miss the upcoming season. Atlanta claimed S Keidron Smith off waivers as the corresponding move.
items.title: Jalon Walker (knee) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys placed TE Princeton Fant on injured reserve.
items.impact: Fant was diagnosed with a torn ACL. He'll miss the upcoming season.
items.title: Princeton Fant (knee) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys claimed TE Zack Kuntz off waivers.
items.impact: Kuntz was waived by the Raiders on Thursday. Dallas placed TE Princeton Fant on injured reserve.
items.title: Zack Kuntz claimed off waivers by Cowboys

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks waived TE Lance Mason.
items.impact: Mason will figure to seek another opportunity. Seattle signed FB Brock Lampe as the corresponding move.
items.title: Lance Mason waived by Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed FB Brock Lampe.
items.impact: Lampe will get an opportunity in training camp for Seattle with Robbie Ouzts sidelined from practice.
items.title: Brock Lampe signs with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers executive vice president of football operations Brandt Tilis was not willing to discuss a potential contract extension for QB Bryce Young.
items.impact: "I would say (Young) ascended last year and there is still room for him to ascend," Tilis told reporters when asked about an extension. "His ceiling is currently unknown and I think that is exciting for us. He's working hard to get himself there." After leading the Panthers to the playoffs last season, Young will look to take another step forward as a passer.
items.title: Bryce Young: Panthers not ready yet to discuss extension

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets RB Isaiah Davis will miss a couple of weeks.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is. "He had a minor knee [injury]," Jets coach Aaron Glenn said. "He'll be out maybe a couple of weeks, but he'll be back. I'm confident that he'll be just fine going into the regular season." Davis is expected to compete for a depth role in the Jets backfield alongside Braelon Allen.
items.title: Isaiah Davis (knee) to miss a couple of weeks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Broncos coach Sean Payton said WR Jaylen Waddle has a "strain" and will return within 4-5 days.
items.impact: Waddle left Wednesday's practice early and returned to work on the rehab field on Thursday. His status will be worth monitoring in practice early next week.
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (muscle strain) expected to miss 4-5 days

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Montez Sweat left practice early on Thursday at Bears training camp.
items.impact: It is unclear what Sweat is dealing with and what the severity is. There should be updates provided by this weekend.
items.title: Montez Sweat leaves practice early Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Braxton Jones left practice early on Thursday at Bears training camp.
items.impact: It is unclear what Jones is dealing with and what the severity is. There should be updates provided by this weekend.
items.title: Braxton Jones exits practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dallis Flowers left practice early on Thursday.
items.impact: Cronin noted it appeared to be a serious injury for Flowers. There should be an update on his status by this weekend.
items.title: Dallis Flowers (leg) leaves practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Malik Nabers participated in some walk-through periods against the defense on Thursday.
items.impact: Nabers continues to be eased back early in training camp. He continues to take steps in the right direction. His status will need to continue to be monitored in practice the next few weeks.
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) participates in walkthrough periods Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kendre Miller did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It appears to be a new knee injury for Miller early in training camp. Devin Neal and Audric Estime should only see more reps in his place.
items.title: Kendre Miller (back) misses practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Broncos WR Courtland Sutton is "being limited as part of the team's 'protocols' for the veteran wide receiver."
items.impact: It explains why Sutton was not seen practicing on Tuesday or Wednesday. He returned to practice on Thursday, but he was still held out of team drills. He should continue to be ramped up as we get closer to the season.
items.title: Courtland Sutton being limited early in training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Patriots WR Romeo Doubs did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It is unclear what Doubs is dealing with as he did not practice on Wednesday either. It should not be a concern this early in training camp.
items.title: Romeo Doubs (undisclosed) does not practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The NFL has suspended Saints WR Brock Rechsteiner for the first six games of the 2026 season.
items.impact: Rechsteiner will still be able to play in the preseason. He could open the season on the practice squad for New Orleans.
items.title: Brock Rechsteiner suspended six games

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jahmyr Gibbs has agreed to 3-year, $67.5 million deal with Lions that could be worth up to $75.75 million. Gibbs is now the NFL's highest paid running back.
items.impact: Gibbs has done everything he needs to to earn this money. He's a premier running back in the NFL, in the argument for the best. Now with David Montgomery gone, we will see how well he can shoulder a workhorse role, and fantasy managers are rightly expecting big things.
items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs agrees to 3-year, $67.5 million deal with Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bengals starters will play in their preseason opener against the Lions.
items.impact: It likely won't be more than one or two series for the starters, but we'll at least get a glimpse at seeing them play.
items.title: Joe Burrow, Bengals starters to play in preseason opener

title: Fantasy Player News
